value.body: Bachelor of Unani Medicine and Surgery. Unani is a Greco-Arabic system of medicine practised in India. You study modern medical basics alongside Unani principles, pharmacology and regimenal therapy, then complete a one-year internship. It is regulated by the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM).

items.label: Course length
items.note: 4½ years of study + 1-year compulsory rotatory internship

items.label: UG seats
items.note: Across ~33 colleges permitted for 2025-26 (list as on 29 Aug 2025); approx. sum
items.source: NCISM list of permitted Unani colleges, approx.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, and a qualifying NEET-UG score. AACCC (Ministry of Ayush) counsels the 15% All India Quota and central, national-institute and deemed-university seats; states fill the rest through their own counselling. Students who have not passed Urdu, Arabic or Persian in Class 10 or 12 study Urdu in the first year.

value.title: At a glance
items: Uttar Pradesh has the largest number of Unani colleges.
Practice needs registration with a State Board or Council of Indian Medicine.
An MD or MS (Unani) through AIAPGET is the usual way to specialise.
